senses.gloss:
(इर टु and ओ) टुओश्वि r. 1st cl. (श्वयति)
1 To move, to go, or go to.
2 To grow, to increase.

(आ) श्विता r. 1st cl. (श्वेतते)
To be white.

n. (-त्रं)
Whiteness of the skin, vitiligo.
E.
श्वित to be white, Uṇādi aff. रक्.

f. (-घ्नी)
A plant, (Tragia involucrata.)
E.
श्वित्र vitiligo, and घ्न destroying.

mfn. (-त्री-त्रिणी-त्रि)
Affected with vitiligo or whiteness of the skin.
E.
श्वित्र, and इनि aff.

(इ) श्विदि r. 1st cl. (श्विंदते)
To be white, to become or continue so.

(ञि आ) ञिष्विदा r. 1st cl. (स्वेदते) r. 4th cl. (स्विद्यति)
1 To perspire, to sweat.
2 To be greasy or unctuous.
3 To be fascinated, to be tempted or deluded.
4 To quit, to yield.

ind.
1 A particle of questioning, (hey, what?)
2 An exclamation of doubt or surprise.
3 An expletive.
E.
सु well, इण् to go, aff. क्विप्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Sweated, melted.
2 Sweating, perspiring.
E.
स्वाद to be unctuous, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Sweating, perspiring.
E.
ष्विद to perspire, क्त aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Assenting, agreeing.
2 Promising.
E.
स्व own, करण making, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 To be promised.
2 To be admitted, consented, or agreed to.
E.
स्व before कृ to make, अनीयर् aff., च्चि augment; also स्वीकर्त्तव्य and स्वीकृत्य.

n. (-रः)
1 Promise.
2 Assent, agreement.
E.
स्व own, कार making, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Not agreed or assented to.
E.
स्वीकार, and रहित void of.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
Agreed to, consequent upon a promise or assent.
E.
स्वीकार, and अन्त end.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Agreed, assented to.
2 Promised.
E.
स्व, and कृत made, च्चि augment.

ind.
Having agreed or promised.
E.
स्व, and कृत्य having made, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Own, relating or belonging to one.
f. (-या)
A virtuous woman, one attached solely to her husband.
E.
स्व own, छ aff.
